metrics.Trust: AUROC on disagreement nodes, target: at least one expert is correct
metrics.Preference: AUROC only on disagreement nodes with at least one correct expert, positive: GNN correct
metrics.D_Prec: Sort disagreement ranking score descending then node ID ascending; routed expert correctness; k=ceil(percent*disagreement count)
metrics.A_Prec: Sort agreement score descending then node ID ascending; common expert prediction correctness; k=ceil(percent*agreement count)
metrics.A_correctness_auroc: Agreement reliability AUROC, supplemental; distinct from disagreement Trust AUROC
metrics.deployed_precision: Correctness of unchanged model accepted nodes within the evaluation pool; its own acceptance budget, not a matched B0 budget
